subject: Coord: On‑Prem / VPC Deep Dive — schedule alignment across engineering, security, procurement
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@medsys.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Coord: On‑Prem / VPC Deep Dive — schedule alignment across engineering, security, procurement

Alex — thanks again for the productive discovery call yesterday. Per our conversation, MedSys has a few moving parts (on‑prem networking team, security/IAM, and procurement) that we want to bring into a single technical deep‑dive. The goal: confirm connectivity options (VPC peering vs. VPN vs. private link), clarify IAM role boundaries, and surface any procurement constraints so we can scope a Dedicated / Private plan and an onboarding checklist.

Proposed format (90 minutes):
- 15m: introductions + goals
- 35m: networking topology & constraints (customer network and firewall patterns)
- 20m: IAM / key management / audit logging review
- 20m: procurement/next steps + action items

Required attendees (please confirm): Marcus Lin (SE, Redwood), MedSys networking lead, Samir Khan (security lead), one procurement representative.

Time options (all US times) — please mark what works for you and your team: 
1) Tue Dec 1, 10:00–11:30 PST / 13:00–14:30 EST
2) Wed Dec 2, 08:00–09:30 PST / 11:00–12:30 EST
3) Thu Dec 3, 15:00–16:30 PST / 18:00–19:30 EST

I've attached a short agenda and a one‑page checklist for materials to have ready. Marcus — can you review and add anything to the agenda? Alex — if you prefer a different cadence or need a shorter session, say the word and we can split into networking + IAM sessions.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_onprem_deepdive_agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@medsys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@medsys.com>, procurement@medsys.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -06:00
Subject: Re: Coord: On‑Prem / VPC Deep Dive — schedule alignment across engineering, security, procurement

Jordan — thanks, this looks good and captures the right scope. Quick notes from our side:
- Networking: I'll bring our network architect (Lisa Chen) — she'll want to review current firewall/NAT patterns and our AWS Direct Connect plans.
- Security/IAM: Samir will be on the call; he flagged questions about KMS/HSM and audit log retention policies.
- Procurement: copying procurement@medsys.com — they need any vendor onboarding docs and an estimated monthly cost range before the technical approval step.

Of the proposed slots, Dec 1 at 10:00 PST conflicts with a board review. Dec 2 at 08:00 PST looks best for engineering + security (we can stretch to 90m). Procurement prefers Tue/Thu mornings pacific.

If you can provision the network questionnaire in advance that would speed things up — that way Lisa can pull diagrams and route tables into the meeting.

I'll tentatively hold Wed Dec 2, 08:00–09:30 PST for our team. Confirm and we'll send a calendar invite with the required attendees.

—Alex
Alex Sanders
Staff Systems Engineer, Integrations | MedSys Health
alex.sanders@medsys.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@medsys.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Coord: On‑Prem / VPC Deep Dive — schedule alignment across engineering, security, procurement

Thanks Alex — great. A couple of pragmatic asks from the SE side so we can be efficient in the 90m: 
1) Please upload a network topology (PDF or Visio) showing routing (NAT/gateway, public subnets) and the firewall vendor + version.
2) Any existing peering/VPN appliance configs (ipsec parameters, ASN if BGP) would be helpful.
3) For IAM, a short list of your expected RBAC roles (e.g., who manages keys, who triggers backups, who has admin vs. read‑only) helps us call out least privilege patterns.

Attached is a short network questionnaire I put together that mirrors what we typically ask in onboarding. If Alex's team can fill this by Monday EOD, Marcus/Jordan can pre‑stage a candidate architecture diagram so the call is focused on decisions, not discovery.

I can make Wed Dec 2, 08:00–09:30 PST. If procurement can't join that window, we can record the session and do a short follow‑up with procurement on Thur morning to align the commercial items.

—Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: rdw_network_questionnaire.xlsx (Excel, 12 rows)
From: procurement@medsys.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@medsys.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@medsys.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Coord: On‑Prem / VPC Deep Dive — schedule alignment across engineering, security, procurement

Jordan — procurement here. Thanks for including us. A few quick items to make the procurement review efficient: 
- Please provide an estimated monthly cost range (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private) and any minimum term/commitment we should be aware of.
- Our vendor onboarding team requires a completed W‑9, vendor policy questionnaire, and standard SOC 2 evidence. If you have a vendor pack or portal link, send it over.
- Windows that work best for procurement syncs are Tue/Thu 09:00–11:00 PST. If you lock Wed Dec 2 with engineering/security, we request a 20–30m procurement-only follow up on Thu Dec 3 at 09:00 PST to finalize commercial items.

We can join the technical call for context, but procurement will mainly use the recording and the packet to move legal/finance forward.

procurement@medsys.com
Vendor Onboarding | MedSys Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@medsys.com>, procurement@medsys.com, Samir Khan <samir.khan@medsys.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Coord: On‑Prem / VPC Deep Dive — schedule alignment across engineering, security, procurement

Thanks everyone — locking this in. Per availability we will run the core technical deep‑dive on: 
- Wed Dec 2, 2026 — 08:00–09:30 PST (90 minutes) — primary attendees: MedSys network engineer (Lisa Chen), Samir Khan (security), Marcus Lin (Redwood SE), Jordan Blake (AE).
- Thu Dec 3, 2026 — 09:00–09:30 PST (procurement follow‑up) — procurement team + Jordan for commercial clarifications.

I've created the calendar invites and attached an .ics. Agenda and the questionnaire responses would be ideal by EOD Tuesday so Marcus can prepare a candidate diagram. For procurement: I'll attach a short vendor packet with estimated committed and burst pricing ranges, and the SOC 2 link.

Meeting resources: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=RDW-DEEPDIVE-20261201
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/RDW-2381/onprem-deepdive

If anything changes for your team, ping me and we'll reschedule. Looking forward to getting the network/IAM constraints nailed down so we can produce an onboarding plan and cost estimate.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachments: calendar_invite_20261201.ics (iCal)
